subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After repairing the four stale assertions, should the token-, registry-, CodeQL-, Blacksmith-, and Codex-bearing action upgrades land together or be split into smaller security review units?
rationale: The proposed commits match official immutable release tags, but the group changes executable code with sensitive credentials, security permissions, publishing access, and Codex execution controls; repository policy and CODEOWNERS leave acceptance of that combined boundary to owners.

options.title: Keep the grouped update
options.body: Repair the assertions and land the group after exact-head workflow/security checks and secops review.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate credential- and security-bearing action families into narrower dependency PRs for smaller supply-chain review units.

recommendation.title: Keep the grouped update
recommendation.body: Repair the assertions and land the group after exact-head workflow/security checks and secops review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI history and direct live-PR involvement make this the best available individual routing candidate, with the secops team still required by CODEOWNERS.
